name: RMXXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: RMX-1000-style remix effect: isolator, DJ filter, Build Up / Break Down scenes, synced echo, Release FX and a Release kill switch, EQ Kill buttons, a clean Panic, Clouds, Dragonfly reverbs, sample pads with ADSR, 16 user presets and a brickwall limiter, with a big-button touchscreen skin and Q-Links.
